title.narrative: Cote d'Ivoire Youth Employment and Skills Development Project - Phase 3

description.narrative: The PDO is to enhance labor market outcomes for all Project beneficiaries, and strengthen the technical and vocational education and training (TVET) sector.

The Project Development Objective of the Cote d'Ivoire - Third Phase of the Youth Employment and Skills Development Project is to enhance labor market outcomes for all Project beneficiaries, and strengthen the technical and vocational education and training (TVET) sector. The project will consist of four components - Component 1: Improving skills training and catalyzing entrepreneurship for job creation through empowered local governments (US$60 million equivalent); Component 2: Strengthening the TVET system's capacity to provide better employment opportunities to and promote entrepreneurship of Ivorian youth (US$80 million equivalent); Component 3: Project management and M&E (US$10 million); Component 4: Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC), (US$0 million).
